The bound circles are GuiLayoutWidget projections. They do not carry a GuiSectionRuntimeImplementation, its canonical GuiWidgetOwner, section fields or emission services. A synthetic Section owner would not be the host widget's real state.

The HUD retains only summary.audio_environment, not the sound manager's SoundConfigurationState/listener table or SoundLevelNameHost. Using an invented listener table would merely round-trip the same environment string; the real application's sound state is outside this host's available interface.
